name: ExtensionObservation_TriggeredBy
title: R5: Triggering observation(s) (new)
purpose:
This extension is part of the cross-version definitions generated to enable use of the
element `Observation.triggeredBy` as defined in FHIR R5
in FHIR R4.

The source element is defined as:
`Observation.triggeredBy` 0..* `BackboneElement`

Across FHIR versions, the element set has been mapped as:
*  R5: `Observation.triggeredBy` 0..* `BackboneElement`

Following are the generation technical comments:
Element `Observation.triggeredBy` has a context of Observation based on following the parent source element upwards and mapping to `Observation`.
Element `Observation.triggeredBy` has no mapping targets in FHIR R4. Typically, this is because the element has been added (is a new element).
